# Marimo Studio 0.1.2

Marimo Studio 0.1.2 improves first-run authoring, Source recovery, Prepared
runtime diagnostics, and workspace navigation.

## Authoring and recovery

- First save preserves the native Marimo session and current public query while
  Studio opens the first durable view route.
- Source retains unsaved edits and the last saved comparison when an authored
  file disappears. Restored files and interrupted saves reconcile against the
  current revision.
- Provider failures identify the affected manifest or source file. Preview
  preparation reports its current phase and retains diagnostics and Retry after
  a successful render.
- Studio follows the native Marimo theme. Reveal.js and Shower presentations
  preserve projected-control keyboard interaction alongside deck navigation.

## Prepared runtime and diagnostics

- Prepared capture and control discovery authenticate against the owning Marimo
  server. Preview activation waits for its runtime frame before synchronizing
  query parameters.
- Runtime failures preserve error codes, recovery guidance, source context, and
  upstream details across HTTP responses, event streams, refreshes, and agent
  observations.
- The preview panel and runtime menu present the same diagnostic with an
  explanation, suggested next step, and copyable technical details.

## Interface and packaging

- Studio uses a stable 36px desktop toolbar with compact navigation and
  controls. Runtime and pop-out actions move into the workspace menu at narrow
  desktop widths.
- Python package metadata publishes compatible lower bounds for htpy,
  marimo-export, Tree-sitter, Tree-sitter JavaScript, and watchdog. Marimo and
  Deno retain their validated runtime versions.

## Compatibility

Marimo Studio 0.1.2 supports Python 3.10 through 3.14 and Marimo 0.24.0. React,
Reveal.js, and Svelte authoring use the optional Deno 2.9.5 dependency.

[All changes since 0.1.1](https://github.com/marimo-team/marimo-studio/compare/v0.1.1...v0.1.2)
